title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 166
paragraphs: In addition, they report that it happened that Gelon and Theron won their victory over Hamilcar the Carthaginian on the very same day when the Greeks won at Salamis over the Persian. This Hamilcar, who was a Carthaginian on his father's side but Syracusan on his mother's, and who had become king of the Carthaginians on his merits, when the engagement took place and he began to be defeated in the battle, disappeared, as I am told; for neither alive nor dead did he appear again anywhere on earth, though Gelon used every effort to search for him.
